Title: Verify Python version compatibility
Description: Verify runtime environment is Python 3.9+ per pyproject.toml.
Test_Steps: 1. Run python --version. 2. Check version string >= 3.9.
Expected_Result: Python version is 3.9 or higher (3.13.7 verified).

Title: Verify official osdagbridge package installation
Description: Verify official package installs via pip in editable mode.
Test_Steps: 1. Execute pip install -e .. 2. Verify build wheel.
Expected_Result: Package osdagbridge installs with status successful.

Title: Verify core package discovery
Description: Verify import of osdagbridge.core and submodules.
Test_Steps: 1. Python import osdagbridge.core. 2. Inspect module spec.
Expected_Result: Module osdagbridge.core resolves to src directory.

Title: Verify CLI launcher command execution
Description: Verify osdagbridge CLI entry point displays command options.
Test_Steps: 1. Run python -m osdagbridge.cli. 2. Check commands list.
Expected_Result: CLI banner and commands options displayed.

Title: Verify desktop module bootstrap entry point
Description: Verify desktop main.start entry point initiates UI bootstrap.
Test_Steps: 1. Import osdagbridge.desktop.main. 2. Call start().
Expected_Result: Desktop bootstrap outputs start message cleanly.

Title: Create new Plate Girder Bridge project
Description: Verify PlateGirderDTO instantiates with unique project name.
Test_Steps: 1. Instantiate PlateGirderDTO with name. 2. Verify fields.
Expected_Result: DTO instance created with specified name.

Title: Save project parameters to JSON
Description: Verify project dictionary can be serialized to JSON file on disk.
Test_Steps: 1. Call to_json(). 2. Write to disk. 3. Verify file.
Expected_Result: JSON file written to disk with exact matching keys.
Actual_Result: File written and validated against schema.

Title: Load project from saved JSON
Description: Verify saved JSON project file can be reopened and deserialized.
Test_Steps: 1. Read JSON file. 2. Call from_json(). 3. Compare values.
Expected_Result: Project object restored with identical parameters.

Title: Handle corrupted project file on load
Description: Verify application catches corrupt JSON syntax gracefully.
Test_Steps: 1. Open truncated JSON file. 2. Trigger parser.
Expected_Result: JSONDecodeError caught and user alerted without crash.

Title: Modify project parameters and save
Description: Verify updating bridge span or steel grade updates saved project.
Test_Steps: 1. Update span_length to 28m. 2. Re-save project.
Expected_Result: Updated parameters reflected in exported file.

Title: Validate standard 24m plate girder inputs
Description: Verify full valid project configuration passes validation.
Test_Steps: 1. Pass 24m geometry to validator. 2. Check result.

Title: Validate 16m single-lane bridge inputs
Description: Verify single-lane bridge configuration passes validation.
Test_Steps: 1. Pass 16m geometry to validator. 2. Check result.

Title: Reject empty required project ID
Description: Verify leaving project_id blank triggers validation error.
Test_Steps: 1. Set project_id=. 2. Run validation.

Title: Reject negative span length
Description: Verify entering negative span is rejected.
Test_Steps: 1. Set span_length=-24.0. 2. Validate.

Title: Reject zero span length
Description: Verify entering 0.0 span length is rejected.
Test_Steps: 1. Set span_length=0.0. 2. Validate.

Title: Enforce span lower boundary (5.0m)
Description: Verify span below 5.0m triggers minimum boundary error.
Test_Steps: 1. Enter span=4.2m. 2. Validate.

Title: Enforce span upper boundary (60.0m)
Description: Verify span above 60.0m triggers maximum boundary error.
Test_Steps: 1. Enter span=72.0m. 2. Validate.

Title: Enforce web thickness corrosion limit (8mm)
Description: Verify web thickness below 8.0mm fails per IRC:24.
Test_Steps: 1. Set web_thickness=6.0mm. 2. Validate.

Title: Reject alphabetic text in numeric fields
Description: Verify non-numeric string in web_depth is rejected.
Test_Steps: 1. Enter ABC_DEPTH in web_depth. 2. Validate.

Title: Reject unsupported steel grade
Description: Verify non-standard steel grade is rejected.
Test_Steps: 1. Select ASTM_A992. 2. Validate.

Title: Execute official preliminary sizing routine
Description: Verify preliminary_sizing() returns sizing dictionary for plate girder.
Test_Steps: 1. Call preliminary_sizing(dto). 2. Inspect result.

Title: Execute official designer module
Description: Verify design() evaluates section sizing checks.
Test_Steps: 1. Call design(dto). 2. Inspect status.

Title: Execute official analyser module
Description: Verify analyse() builds grillage and calls solver.
Test_Steps: 1. Call analyse(dto). 2. Inspect output.

Title: Execute chained official pipeline
Description: Verify execution of DTO -> preliminary sizing -> analyser -> designer.
Test_Steps: 1. Execute pipeline chain. 2. Verify states.

Title: Verify self-weight dead load calculation
Description: Verify dead load bending moment for 24m plate girder.
Test_Steps: 1. Calculate dead load UDL. 2. Compute M_DL.

Title: Verify IRC Class 70R live load moment
Description: Verify live load moment and impact factor per IRC:6.
Test_Steps: 1. Calculate live load share. 2. Apply impact.

Title: Verify section moment capacity Md
Description: Verify moment capacity calculation complies with IS 800 Cl 8.2.
Test_Steps: 1. Compute Z_p and Md. 2. Compare with IRC ref.
Expected_Result: Moment capacity falls within IRC reference tolerance.

Title: Verify section shear capacity Vd
Description: Verify shear capacity complies with IS 800 Cl 8.4.
Test_Steps: 1. Compute Av and Vd. 2. Compare capacity.
Expected_Result: Shear capacity falls within IRC reference tolerance.

Title: Verify live load deflection check (L/800)
Description: Verify deflection ratio does not exceed IRC:24 Cl 505 limit.
Test_Steps: 1. Compute delta_LL. 2. Compare against L/800.

Title: Detect failure under extreme span (60m)
Description: Verify solver flags limit state violation for 60m girder.
Test_Steps: 1. Run solver with default sections. 2. Check status.
Expected_Result: Flags deflection or moment capacity deficit (FAIL).

Title: Verify material grade yield scaling (E250 vs E350)
Description: Verify capacity scales by ratio 350/250 = 1.40.
Test_Steps: 1. Compute Md for both. 2. Check ratio.

Title: Inspect 3D CAD visualization canvas
Description: Verify CAD view renders 3 girders, deck, and stiffeners.
Test_Steps: 1. Open 3D visualization canvas. 2. Inspect mesh.
Actual_Result: CAD view rendered SVG geometry nodes.

Title: Inspect girder cross-section view
Description: Verify cross-section drawing displays web and flange dimensions.
Test_Steps: 1. Switch to Cross-Section view. 2. Verify labels.
Expected_Result: Section labels show top flange, web, and bottom flange.

Title: Inspect design check summary cards
Description: Verify utilization cards display demand, capacity, and status.
Test_Steps: 1. Switch to Summary cards tab. 2. Inspect ratios.
Expected_Result: Four cards displayed with clause references.
Actual_Result: Moment, shear, and deflection cards displayed.

Title: Inspect application execution logs
Description: Verify application logger writes timestamped traces.
Test_Steps: 1. Open osdagbridge_qa.log. 2. Verify timestamps.
Expected_Result: Log entries contain ISO8601 timestamps and levels.
Actual_Result: Log traces captured with level tags.

Title: Generate engineering Markdown calculation report
Description: Verify markdown report contains all 5 mandatory sections.
Test_Steps: 1. Generate markdown report. 2. Check headings.
Expected_Result: Report contains project info, geometry, and checks.

Title: Generate printable HTML design report
Description: Verify HTML report includes styled tables and status badges.
Test_Steps: 1. Generate HTML report. 2. Inspect markup.
Expected_Result: HTML markup contains doctype, tables, and css styles.

Title: Verify code compliance table in report
Description: Verify report table includes IS 800 & IRC:24 clause references.
Test_Steps: 1. Check table rows. 2. Verify clause strings.
Expected_Result: Table contains Cl 8.2, Cl 8.4, and IRC:24 Cl 505.

Title: Export tabular results to CSV
Description: Verify verification matrix exports to valid CSV spreadsheet.
Test_Steps: 1. Export check table to CSV. 2. Check headers.
Expected_Result: CSV contains check_name, actual, allowable, and status.
Actual_Result: CSV generated with valid headers and data.

Title: Verify Unicode path resilience in report save
Description: Verify saving report to folder with Unicode symbols succeeds.
Test_Steps: 1. Save report to folder with Hindi/Unicode characters.
Expected_Result: File is saved without raising unhandled OS error.
Actual_Result: File saved successfully to Unicode path.

Title: Handle missing girder dimensions in solver
Description: Verify solver blocks execution if girder geometry is omitted.
Test_Steps: 1. Pass payload missing girder block. 2. Solve.

Title: Enforce minimum 2 girders requirement
Description: Verify single-girder bridge raises error during validation.
Test_Steps: 1. Set number_of_main_girders=1. 2. Validate.

Title: Web slenderness ratio boundary warning (d/tw > 200)
Description: Verify warning flagged when web slenderness exceeds 200.
Test_Steps: 1. Enter web depth=2000, thickness=8. 2. Validate.

Title: Handle solver failure on corrupted inputs
Description: Verify solver does not crash interpreter when input has errors.
Test_Steps: 1. Pass invalid model to solver. 2. Observe exception.
Expected_Result: Solver safely rejects model with ValidationError.

Title: Prevent execution on blank project configuration
Description: Verify empty payload dictionary is rejected immediately.
Test_Steps: 1. Pass empty dict to validator. 2. Check errors.
Expected_Result: Returns is_valid=False with multiple missing field errors.

Title: REG-01: Rapid alphabetic keystroke injection
Description: Verify numeric inputs reject strings during rapid input (OB-BUG-005).
Test_Steps: 1. Paste alphabetic string in numeric field. 2. Run.

Title: REG-02: Zero web thickness division-by-zero guard
Description: Verify zero web thickness does not cause ZeroDivisionError (OB-BUG-004).
Test_Steps: 1. Set web thickness = 0.0mm. 2. Validate.

Title: REG-03: Corrupt JSON file open alert
Description: Verify corrupted project JSON raises handled alert (OB-BUG-003).
Test_Steps: 1. Load corrupted JSON file. 2. Verify alert.

Title: REG-04: Unicode export file writing
Description: Verify exporting PDF/HTML to Unicode directories succeeds (OB-BUG-006).
Test_Steps: 1. Export report to Unicode path. 2. Verify file.

Title: REG-05: IRC:6 impact factor clamping for long spans
Description: Verify impact factor clamped between 0.10 and 0.35 (OB-BUG-007).
Test_Steps: 1. Calculate impact factor 4.5/(6+L). 2. Check clamp.
